trailhead.label: Rotwand gondola top station, Rotwandwiesen, the board’s start

cautions: A descent of about 570 m: take it slowly on the steeper path 17.
Forest road shared with forestry vehicles and pushchairs.
Check the Rotwand gondola is running before you set out.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
